Reference Court at the rate of Rs.120/- per square yard was the correct measure and
that the market value determined by the High Court could not be sustained either on

the basis of the sale-deeds or on the strength of judicial order.
We have gone through the contents of the Review Petitions. None of the
ground raised in support of the Review Petitions makes out any error apparent on

record to justify interference in Review Jurisdiction.
All the Review Petitions are, therefore, dismissed.
…………………………J.
 [Uday Umesh Lalit]
